newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.6 bln for week of Feb 17.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.6 bln for week of Feb 17.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for the week of February 17 are tentatively expected to total $1.6 billion in 81 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $475 million in 52 sales. The largest is a $65 Arlington ISD, Texas, issue on February 20.
Negotiated sales total $1.2 billion in 29 offerings. The largest is a $247 million Hempstead IDA, N.Y., offering through Smith Barney inc.
